Round 6 source check (2026-10-13): the 27 points are kept here, not simulated. The official EAW EASE page currently offers Standard EASE rev18 and EASE GLL v1.11 archives, but its page does not identify a KF760 entry and the archives have not been inspected. EAW's 2023 announcement described RADIUS as its first GLL and said KF-line GLLs were planned; this does not confirm a KF760 file in the later archive. notes: The exact Martin Audio W8LM manufacturer archive page and datasheet describe a three-way mini line-array cabinet with two 8-inch LF+MF drivers (each specified with a 2-inch/50 mm voice coil) and two 1-inch HF compression drivers, four transducers total. The datasheet publishes 60 Hz–18 kHz ±3 dB (on-axis, open 4π space, measured at 2 m and referred to 1 m), 12-ohm full-range impedance, and 400 W AES / 1600 W peak passive power handling; the scalar power stores the explicitly stated passive AES rating (the separate bi-amp LF+MF and HF ratings are mode/component-specific). Sensitivity is specified separately for LF+MF (100 dB), HF (106 dB), and full range (99 dB rising to 105 dB at HF); its footnote states 1 W, open 4π space at 2 m, band-limited pink noise, referred to 1 m. Because the scalar field cannot represent these band/mode-specific figures, no sensitivity scalar is assigned. The speaker requires external amplification; its selectable passive/bi-amp crossover does not make it self-powered. The datasheet has a partial angle-resolved table (0°–50°, 2–20 kHz, dB SPL/2.83 V with 1/3-octave smoothing), frequency-dependent HF horizontal beamwidth, nominal coverage and polar plots; these do not supply the complete full-band angle-resolved response required for a directivity payload. The 2–20 kHz table also cannot stand in for a full-band response curve or safely replace the separately published 60 Hz–18 kHz limits, so neither curve nor directivity pattern is imported.
